method.training_samples: participants outside the evaluated outer fold only
method.candidate_anchor: independent IBD entity with frozen strict GNPS Gold/Silver library support for candidate InChIKey
method.features: median detection Jaccard, joint-detection Spearman correlation, and their signed product
method.wrong_context: frozen whole-profile permutation within exact training detection degree
method.fair_evaluation_subset: paired_context_available only; all other candidate edges remain explicit context abstentions

leakage_status: diagnosis, beta, SE, contrast label, held-out effects and retrieval truth were not loaded; only complementary-fold sample profiles and frozen phenotype-blind library anchors were used
claim_boundary: This is candidate-specific event evidence, not a validated BioAware performance gain.
Strict library support is an anchor policy, not MSI level-1 identity.
Missing candidate context is abstention and must never be converted to negative evidence.
Promotion requires real context to outperform degree-preserving wrong context on downstream held-out biological answers.
